description: This file adds an event listener for DOMContentLoaded and sets up a click handler for an element with class 'big-button' to log a message and toggle a class for visual feedback.

methods.name: DOMContentLoaded event listener
methods.description: Initializes the script after the DOM content is fully loaded.

methods.name: click event handler for 'big-button'
methods.description: Handles click events on the button, logs a message, and toggles 'clicked' class.
